FreeAP

A local Wi-Fi lab running on an Arduino UNO R4 WiFi with an Air780EU modem for SMS commands.

Open the device portal

  1. Join BACKUP-Lab from your Wi-Fi settings.
  2. If the sign-in prompt doesn’t appear, open the AP address printed in Arduino Serial Monitor at 115200 baud.
  3. Enter a cell number to connect to the local demo. This portal works offline. Use the portal’s FreeAP account link to complete the lab over HTTPS.

Open /admin on the Arduino’s AP address to view lab sessions and sign-in results.

SMS commands

Text HELP to the modem SIM from your configured admin number to see the command list.
